components.name: Alert.Actions
components.description: A wrapping row of buttons or links under the text.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons or links.

components.name: Alert.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root at the end of the first row. The alert has no open state, so remove it in onClick.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits, such as "Got it", names the button by itself. Otherwise the dismiss string from StringsProvider names it, Dismiss in English.
props.default: "Dismiss" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Hide the alert here.

components.name: Alert.Description
components.description: Detail under the title. A div element, so it can hold paragraphs or a list.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

components.name: Alert.Icon
components.description: Slot for any icon, placed before the text. aria-hidden by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon graphic from your own icon set.

components.name: Alert.Root
components.description: A status message in one of four tones. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors from color.status.<tone> through the alert contract tokens. Also picks the default role.

props.name: role
props.description: Live region role. Pass role="none" for a banner that is on the page from the start.
props.default: "status" for info and success, "alert" for warning and critical

props.name: children
props.description: Alert parts, or any content.

components.name: Alert.Title
components.description: Short summary, set in the title weight. A p element.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Avatar.Fallback
components.description: Shows until the image loads, and stays when it fails or there is none. Takes native span attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Initials or an icon.

components.name: Avatar.Image
components.description: An img drawn over the fallback, which is removed once the image loads and stays when it fails. Its alt is always empty, because Avatar.Root carries the name. Takes native img attributes except alt.

props.name: src
props.description: The image, or srcSet in its place. Without either, or when it fails to load, the fallback stays.

components.name: Avatar.Root
components.description: A span that shows an image, or a fallback while it loads, when it fails or when there is none. Named by label as one image (role="img"); without label it is hidden from assistive technology. Takes native span attributes except role, aria-label and aria-labelledby.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the avatar, whichever of the image and the fallback shows. Leave it out when the name is written next to the avatar.

props.name: size
props.description: Size from the avatar.size contract tokens.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors behind the fallback. neutral reads avatar.bg and avatar.fg; other tones read the avatar.<tone> contract tokens. categoryTone(id) picks a stable category per person.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar.Image and Avatar.Fallback.

components.name: Badge.Root
components.description: A short static label or count in a status or category tone. A span with no role; takes native span attributes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors from the badge.<tone> contract tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text or a number.

components.name: BottomSheet.Body
components.description: Scroll container. Drag starts only at scrollTop 0.

components.name: BottomSheet.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that requests close-button dismiss.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits, such as "Cancel", names the button by itself. Otherwise the close string from StringsProvider names it, Close in English.
props.default: "Close" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the close request. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the sheet open.

components.name: BottomSheet.Description
components.description: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby.

props.name: children
props.description: Description text.

components.name: BottomSheet.Footer
components.description: Action row.

components.name: BottomSheet.Grabber
components.description: Drag handle. Rendered by default if omitted. Arrow keys change snap.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the resize control. Default is the resizeSheet string from StringsProvider.

components.name: BottomSheet.Header
components.description: Chrome. Drag-eligible.

components.name: BottomSheet.Root
components.description: Modal bottom sheet on a native <dialog> opened with showModal(). Mid and full snap.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out for an uncontrolled sheet.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Shows the sheet on mount when uncontrolled. There is no trigger part, so once closed it opens again only on remount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests. When controlled, staying open keeps the sheet open. reason is "form" for a <form method="dialog"> submit (read returnValue) and "native" when something else outside Todae closed the <dialog>; when controlled, it shows again while open stays true.

props.name: snap
props.description: Controlled snap. Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSnap
props.description: Initial snap when uncontrolled.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Allowed snaps. ["full"] disables mid.

props.name: dismissOnEscape
props.description: Escape calls onOpenChange(false, "escape"). false sets closedby="none", so the browser ignores the close request.

props.name: dismissOnBackdrop
props.description: Scrim click calls onOpenChange(false, "backdrop").

props.name: dismissOnDrag
props.description: Drag past the threshold dismisses.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when BottomSheet.Title is omitted.

components.name: BottomSheet.Title
components.description: Heading. Wires aria-labelledby.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Breadcrumbs.Item
components.description: One step in the trail. An li; takes native li attributes.

props.name: current
props.description: Wraps the text in a span with aria-current="page", marking the page you are on. Give it plain text, not a link.

props.name: children
props.description: A link to the page, such as an a element or your router's link.

components.name: Breadcrumbs.Root
components.description: A nav landmark with an ordered list of the pages above this one. Takes native nav attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Landmark name. Default is the breadcrumbs string from StringsProvider; the server entry always uses English.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of an element that names the landmark. When set, the default name is dropped.

props.name: separator
props.description: Text drawn between items. Screen readers skip it.

props.name: children
props.description: Breadcrumbs.Item elements, from the top page down to this one.

components.name: Button.Group
components.description: Chrome-only attached row of Button.Root. role=group. No selection state.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

props.name: children
props.description: Button.Root children. Horizontal only.

components.name: Button.Icon
components.description: Order-only decorative icon. Always aria-hidden. No side prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon graphic.

components.name: Button.Root
components.description: Native button. Owns variant, type, and disabled. Default type is button.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. Non-primary sets data-button-variant.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required accessible name when the only child is Button.Icon. Auto-tip text for icon-only.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Icon-only tips the accessible name. Overflowing labels tip the full string. False opts out. Never tips a fitting labeled button.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled pressed state. Makes the button a toggle with aria-pressed.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Starting pressed state for an uncontrolled toggle. Makes the button a toggle with aria-pressed.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when a toggle is clicked. onClick runs first; preventDefault() there skips the change.

props.name: children
props.description: Label and optional Button.Icon. Order is leading or trailing.

components.name: Card.Body
components.description: Main content of the card. A div.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

components.name: Card.Footer
components.description: Actions at the end of the card, in a wrapping row aligned to the end. A div.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons or links.

components.name: Card.Header
components.description: Top of the card, for a heading and a short description. A div; headings inside lose their outer margin.

props.name: children
props.description: A heading of the level that fits the page, and optional text.

components.name: Card.Root
components.description: A bordered surface from the card tokens. A div with no role; takes native div attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Card parts, or any content.

components.name: Checkbox.Root
components.description: Native checkbox. Children are the visible label. Never indeterminate.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Clicking the text toggles the input.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state. Defined means controlled.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires after the checked state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid and sets aria-invalid.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input name.

props.name: value
props.description: Native input value.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: Chip.Root
components.description: Text-only label with optional named remove button. Overflow +N is Chip.Overflow.

props.name: children
props.description: Chip label. Text only.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral reads the chip.bg, chip.fg and chip.border state tokens; other tones read the chip.<tone> contract tokens. A disabled chip takes the disabled colors instead.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Renders a named remove button.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Remove button aria-label. Default is the removeChip string from StringsProvider, Remove {label} in English.

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: Remove button content, such as an icon from your own set. Without it, the close glyph from GlyphsProvider, else Todae's cross.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the remove button.

components.name: ChipList.Root
components.description: A list of chips that folds the ones past maxRows into a +N button, which opens a popover with the rest. Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: chips
props.description: Chip labels, in order.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows to show before folding the rest into +N. Without it, every chip wraps onto as many rows as it needs.

props.name: getKey
props.description: A stable, unique key for each chip, so focus can follow it when chips change. Without it, chips are matched by value, so focus can land on another chip with the same value.

props.name: getTone
props.description: Each chip's tone, such as (value) => categoryTone(value). Without it, every chip is neutral.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Renders a remove button on each chip. Once chips drops the focused chip, focus moves to the chip that now fills its place, else the one before it, else +N, else the list.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Remove button name. Default is the removeChip string from StringsProvider, Remove {value} in English.

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: Remove button content, such as an icon from your own set. Without it, the close glyph from GlyphsProvider, else Todae's cross.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: +N button name. Default is the moreChips string from StringsProvider, {n} more in English.

props.name: panelLabel
props.description: Name of the popover with the folded chips. Default is the moreChipsPanel string from StringsProvider, {n} more chips or 1 more chip in English.

components.name: Code.Block
components.description: A native pre styled from the code.block tokens. It scrolls sideways when a line is too long; takes native pre attributes.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Set 0 when the block can scroll, so keyboard users can reach and scroll it.

props.name: children
props.description: The code, usually in a code element, which drops its own box here.

components.name: Code.Root
components.description: A native code styled from the code tokens: inline, in the text color around it, on a box tinted from that color. Takes native code attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The code.

components.name: createToaster
components.description: Returns a toast store { add, update, dismiss, remove, subscribe, getSnapshot } that works outside React. Make one per app at module scope and pass it to Toast.Region. add() takes id, tone, title, description, duration and any fields of your own, and returns the id; an id that is still showing is replaced in place.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default milliseconds before a toast dismisses itself. Infinity keeps toasts until dismissed.

components.name: DensityProvider
components.description: Sets data-density for spacing-only compact, comfortable, or spacious.

props.name: density
props.description: Spacing density written to data-density.

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree that inherits density tokens.

components.name: Description.Root
components.description: Supporting text below a control. Required id. Sibling, not a Field part. Author wires aria-describedby.

props.name: id
props.description: Id the author lists in aria-describedby on the control or Field.Root.

props.name: children
props.description: Hint text.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the span.

components.name: Dialog.Body
components.description: Scrollable body.

components.name: Dialog.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that requests close-button dismiss.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits, such as "Cancel", names the button by itself. Otherwise the close string from StringsProvider names it, Close in English.
props.default: "Close" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the close request. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the dialog open.

components.name: Dialog.Description
components.description: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby on the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Description text.

components.name: Dialog.Footer
components.description: Action row.

components.name: Dialog.Header
components.description: Optional header row.

components.name: Dialog.Root
components.description: Native modal dialog. Stays centered. No sheet morph.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out for an uncontrolled dialog.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Shows the dialog on mount when uncontrolled. There is no trigger part, so once closed it opens again only on remount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests. When controlled, staying open keeps the dialog open. Reasons: escape, backdrop, close-button, form (a <form method="dialog"> submit; the submitter value is on the element returnValue), native (something else closed the element).

props.name: dismissOnEscape
props.description: Escape calls onOpenChange(false, "escape").

props.name: dismissOnBackdrop
props.description: Scrim click calls onOpenChange(false, "backdrop").

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when Dialog.Title is omitted.

components.name: Dialog.Title
components.description: Heading. Wires aria-labelledby on the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Disclosure.Root
components.description: A native details styled from the disclosure tokens. Takes native details attributes.

props.name: name
props.description: Disclosures with the same name form an exclusive accordion: the browser keeps at most one open, and a rule divides them.

props.name: open
props.description: Starts the disclosure open. The browser then owns the state; follow it with onToggle.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called after the disclosure opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.description: A Disclosure.Summary first, then the content it shows and hides.

components.name: Disclosure.Summary
components.description: A native summary: the toggle that stays visible. Takes native summary attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The toggle text. It names the disclosure for screen readers.

components.name: Drawer.Root
components.description: Native modal dialog pinned to the start or end edge, full height. Uses Dialog parts inside.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out for an uncontrolled drawer.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Shows the drawer on mount when uncontrolled. There is no trigger part, so once closed it opens again only on remount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests, with the same reasons as Dialog.Root.

props.name: side
props.description: Inline edge it is pinned to. Follows text direction.

props.name: dismissOnEscape
props.description: Escape calls onOpenChange(false, "escape").

props.name: dismissOnBackdrop
props.description: Scrim click calls onOpenChange(false, "backdrop").

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when Dialog.Title is omitted.

components.name: ErrorMessage.Root
components.description: Validation text below a control. Required id. No alert role. invalid lives on the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Id the author lists in aria-describedby on the control or Field.Root.

props.name: children
props.description: Error text.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the span.

components.name: Field.Affix
components.description: Order-only text adornment. Not clickable. No side prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Affix content. Strings render as text.

components.name: Field.ChipInput
components.description: Controlled chips plus input inside Field.Root. Commit does not mutate chips. maxRows uses model B.

props.name: chips
props.description: Controlled chip labels.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled input text.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Input text changes.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Fires on a commit key with a trimmed non-empty value. Does not append chips.

props.name: onChipRemove
props.description: Remove button click or Backspace on an empty input.

props.name: chipRemoveLabel
props.description: Remove button name. Default is the removeChip string from StringsProvider, Remove {value} in English.

props.name: chipRemoveIcon
props.description: Chip remove button content, such as an icon from your own set. Without it, the close glyph from GlyphsProvider, else Todae's cross.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: +N name. Default is the moreChips string from StringsProvider, {n} more in English.

props.name: commitKeys
props.description: Closed allowlist of commit keys.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Caps visual rows. inline: chips plus input. row: chip lines only; the input keeps its own line. Newest chips fold into +N. A chip that does not fit at full width moves into +N. Only a chip wider than the row truncates.

props.name: chipLayout
props.description: inline: chips flow beside the input. row: chips sit in a full-width line above the input, inside the ChipInput; Icon and Affix sit on the first line; no chips renders a one-line field the height of TextInput.

props.name: removeOnBackspace
props.description: Backspace on an empty input removes the last chip.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder.

components.name: Field.Counter
components.description: Live character count for Field.TextInput or Field.Textarea. Its screen reader text comes from the characterLimit, charactersLeft and characterLimitReached strings of StringsProvider.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the count. Use it for the inline flex-basis override.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style. flex-basis: auto places the count on the input row.

components.name: Field.Icon
components.description: Order-only icon. Decorative unless interactive. No side prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon or control.

props.name: interactive
props.description: When false, the wrapper is aria-hidden.

components.name: Field.Root
components.description: Field chrome only. No value. Children render in source order.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and marks the shell.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the shell invalid and sets aria-invalid on the input.

props.name: id
props.description: Input id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Ids of Description and ErrorMessage. Put this on Root. Input parts add their own ids after these.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input name.

props.name: ref
props.description: Shell element. Use as a Popover anchorRef.

props.name: children
props.description: TextInput or ChipInput plus optional Icon and Affix. Order is leading/trailing.

components.name: Field.Row
components.description: Full-width line of parts inside Field.Root. Placement = where it is written. Empty Row renders nothing.

props.name: children
props.description: Parts for the line, such as chips, buttons or Field.Counter.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the row.

components.name: Field.Select
components.description: Controlled native <select> inside Field.Root. The picker is styled from tokens where appearance: base-select is supported.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler. Optional when onValueChange is enough.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional value callback.

props.name: children
props.description: Native <option> and <optgroup> elements.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the select.

components.name: Field.Textarea
components.description: Controlled multi-line text inside Field.Root. Height is CSS only.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional value callback.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder.

props.name: rows
props.description: Starting height in rows. Also the native rows attribute and the drag floor.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Caps autoGrow and drag-resize. Omitted means no cap.

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grows with content up to maxRows using CSS only. No maxRows means no cap.

components.name: Field.TextInput
components.description: Controlled text-ish input inside Field.Root.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional value callback.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input type. Number, date and time keep the native spinner and picker, and value stays the input string, such as "2026-10-07".

components.name: Fieldset.Legend
components.description: The native legend that names the group. Render it as the first child of Fieldset.Root.

props.name: children
props.description: Group name.

components.name: Fieldset.Root
components.description: A native fieldset that groups related controls, such as a set of checkboxes, under one Legend. Takes native fieldset attributes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled: every form control inside is disabled. Todae controls inside also show their disabled style.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the Todae controls inside invalid (aria-invalid and the invalid style); a control with invalid={false} opts out. A fieldset has no aria-invalid of its own, so point aria-describedby at an ErrorMessage.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Ids of a Description or ErrorMessage for the whole group.

props.name: children
props.description: A Fieldset.Legend first, then the controls.

components.name: GlyphsProvider
components.description: Sets the glyphs Todae draws by itself, such as close crosses, check marks and chevrons, for its subtree, so they can come from your icon library. Renders no element; useGlyphs() reads the glyphs in effect.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: The glyphs to change: close, check, chevron, separator and ellipsis. Each key left out comes from the nearest GlyphsProvider above; null brings back Todae's own. A part's own content still wins.

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree that uses these glyphs.

components.name: Grid.Root
components.description: CSS grid layout, the two-axis partner to Stack. Gap comes from the grid.gap contract token. Pass at most one of columns or minItemSize; with neither, set gridTemplateColumns yourself.

props.name: columns
props.description: A fixed number of equal columns, a whole number from 1.

props.name: minItemSize
props.description: The narrowest a column may get, as a CSS length such as "12rem". As many columns fit as the width allows.

props.name: children
props.description: Laid-out children.

components.name: Kbd.Root
components.description: A native kbd drawn as a key cap from the kbd tokens. One with keys or samp inside stays plain text. Takes native kbd attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: A key name, or for a shortcut one Kbd.Root per key.

components.name: Label.Root
components.description: Visible name for a control. Sibling, not a Field part. Pass htmlFor the control id.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Id of the labelled control. Must match Field.Root id when captioning a Field.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text. A required mark is authored here when needed.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the native label.

components.name: Link.Root
components.description: A link styled from the link tokens. Renders an a, or a router link through render; takes native a attributes.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes. Without it the element is not a link and gets no link style.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders something other than a plain a, such as a router link. It receives every prop, the class name included, and must pass them to an a.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Marks the link to the current page or step; its underline thickens.

props.name: children
props.description: The link text.

components.name: Menu.CheckboxItem
components.description: role="menuitemcheckbox". Toggles aria-checked; stays open by default.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires with the next checked state.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu after toggling.

props.name: disabled
props.description: aria-disabled. Stays in the arrow-key order, so it is announced, but cannot be chosen.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Typeahead text when children are not plain text.

props.name: children
props.description: Item label.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.Content

props.description: Names the menu instead of the trigger.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that names the menu. Default is the trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Items, groups and separators.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.Group

props.description: Group name. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible group caption.

props.name: children
props.description: Items.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

props.description: Runs when the item is chosen.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu after choosing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: aria-disabled. Stays in the arrow-key order, so it is announced, but cannot be chosen.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Typeahead text when children are not plain text.

props.name: children
props.description: Item label.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.RadioGroup

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. null is controlled with nothing checked.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next value.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Group name. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible group caption.

props.name: children

props.description: Optional class.

props.name: open

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger label.

props.name: max

props.name: high

components.name: OptionList.Option

props.name: value

props.name: children

components.name: OptionList.Root

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value, or values when selectionMode is multiple.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Selection change. Single passes a string. Multiple passes the next array.

props.name: id
props.description: Listbox id. Auto-generated when omitted. Option ids derive from it.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Listbox tabIndex. Pass -1 when a combobox input owns focus.

props.name: activeValue

props.name: onActiveValueChange
props.description: Fires when keyboard or pointer moves the highlight.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when no visible label is present.

components.name: Pagination.Ellipsis

props.name: children
props.description: What the gap shows.

components.name: Pagination.Item

props.name: children
props.description: A link or button.

components.name: Pagination.Root
components.description: A nav landmark around an ordered list of pages. Named by the pagination string from StringsProvider ("Pagination" in English; always English in the server entry) unless a non-empty aria-label or aria-labelledby is passed. Takes native nav attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Pagination.Item and Pagination.Ellipsis parts, often from paginationRange.

components.name: paginationRange
components.description: Returns the pages to show as numbers, with "start-ellipsis" and "end-ellipsis" for the gaps. While there are more pages than slots the list keeps one length, and a gap always stands for two or more pages.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, from 1. Clamped to 1..count.

props.name: count
props.description: How many pages there are. Below 1, or not a finite number, gives an empty list.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

props.name: boundaries
props.description: Pages always shown at each end.

components.name: Popover.Root
components.description: Surface chrome. Spread getPopoverProps for wire.

props.name: children
props.description: Popover contents.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the surface.

props.name: style
props.description: Style for the surface. Anchor position comes from getPopoverProps.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Only with role="dialog"; a role-less popover drops it, so name its contents instead.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Only with role="dialog"; a role-less popover drops it.

props.name: role
props.description: Non-modal dialog role. Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby. Does not set aria-modal.

components.name: Progress.Root
components.description: A native progress drawn as a track and a fill from the progress tokens. Takes native progress attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: How far the task has come, from 0 to max. Leave it out when the end is unknown: a band sweeps the track.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at which the task is done.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the bar when no label element points at it. Every progress bar needs a name.

props.name: children
props.description: The value as text, for browsers that do not draw the bar.

components.name: RadioGroup.Item
components.description: One option in a RadioGroup. No checked, name, or invalid. Children are the visible label.

props.name: value
props.description: Option value. The group owns selection.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this option. The group disabled flag also applies.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: RadioGroup.Root
components.description: Exclusive choice. Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby. Owns value, name, disabled, and invalid.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. null is controlled with nothing selected. Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next selected value.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared native name. Generated when omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every radio.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks every radio invalid.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout and aria-orientation.

props.name: children
props.description: RadioGroup.Item children.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the radiogroup.

components.name: ScrollArea.Root
components.description: A div that scrolls and keeps the focus rings of what it holds whole: its children sit in a content box padded by a ring's room, and it scroll-pads by the same. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: axis
props.description: The direction it scrolls in. The other direction is clipped.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Whether it takes a Tab stop, so a keyboard can scroll it, while its content overflows. Without it, only when nothing inside can take focus. Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby when it can take one.

components.name: Separator.Root
components.description: A native hr drawn from the separator tokens. It keeps the separator role; takes native hr attributes.

components.name: Skeleton.Root
components.description: A placeholder block from the skeleton tokens, shown while content loads. A div with no role; takes native div attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Elements that only give it a size; they are hidden.

components.name: Slider.Root
components.description: A native range input tinted from the slider tokens. Takes native input attributes except type.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value.

props.name: step
props.description: How far one arrow key moves the value.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, with onChange. Use defaultValue to leave it to the input.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: What a screen reader says instead of the number, such as "40%" or "Medium".

components.name: Spinner.Root
components.description: A native progress with no value, drawn as a turning ring from the spinner tokens. Takes native progress attributes except value and max.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the spinner when it is not inside a label with text. It keeps the progressbar role, so it needs a name.

components.name: Stack.Root
components.description: Flex layout. Gap comes from the stack.gap contract token.

props.name: direction
props.description: Flex direction.

props.name: children
props.description: Laid-out children.

components.name: StringsProvider
components.description: Sets the text Todae writes by itself, such as default accessible names and Field.Counter messages, for its subtree. Renders no element; useStrings() reads the strings in effect.

props.name: strings
props.description: The strings to change. Each key left out comes from the nearest StringsProvider above, else English. A component prop such as aria-label still wins.

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree that uses these strings.

components.name: Switch.Root
components.description: On or off. Track and thumb. Children are the visible label. No check glyph.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Clicking the text toggles the switch.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled on state. Defined means controlled.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial on state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires after the on state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid and sets aria-invalid.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input name.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: Table.Body
components.description: A native tbody. Takes native tbody attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Table.Row parts with the data.

components.name: Table.Caption
components.description: A native caption: the table's name for screen readers. Put it first in Table.Root; takes native caption attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: What the table holds.

components.name: Table.Cell
components.description: A native td styled from the table tokens. Takes native td attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The cell content.

components.name: Table.Foot
components.description: A native tfoot, for totals or notes under the data. Takes native tfoot attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Table.Row parts with the totals.

components.name: Table.Head
components.description: A native thead. The Table.HeaderCell parts in its rows sit above a stronger rule. Takes native thead attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Table.Row parts with the column headers.

components.name: Table.HeaderCell
components.description: A native th styled from the table tokens: a column or row header. Takes native th attributes.

props.name: scope
props.description: Which cells it heads: col, row, colgroup or rowgroup. Use col in Table.Head and row for the first cell of a body row.

props.name: children
props.description: The header text.

components.name: Table.Root
components.description: A native table styled from the table tokens. Takes native table attributes; build its caption, rows and cells from the Table parts.

props.name: children
props.description: A Table.Caption, then Table.Head, Table.Body and Table.Foot with their rows and cells.

components.name: Table.Row
components.description: A native tr. Takes native tr attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Table.HeaderCell and Table.Cell parts.

components.name: Tabs.List
components.description: The tablist. Holds one tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the tablist when no visible caption exists.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible caption for the tablist.

props.name: children
props.description: Tabs.Tab children.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the tablist.

components.name: Tabs.Panel
components.description: role="tabpanel", labelled by its tab. Hidden unless its tab is selected.

props.name: value
props.description: Matches a Tabs.Tab value.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep children mounted while hidden, so their state survives a tab switch.

props.name: children
props.description: Panel content.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the panel.

components.name: Tabs.Root
components.description: Owns the selected tab. Takes value with onValueChange, or defaultValue.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab. Pass with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected tab when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next selected tab.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Arrow keys, layout and aria-orientation.

props.name: activation
props.description: automatic selects on focus. manual waits for Enter, Space or a click.

props.name: children
props.description: Tabs.List and Tabs.Panel.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the root.

components.name: Tabs.Tab
components.description: A native button with role="tab". Controls the Tabs.Panel with the same value.

props.name: value
props.description: Matches a Tabs.Panel value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled. Skipped by arrow keys.

props.name: children
props.description: Tab label.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the tab.

components.name: Text.Root
components.description: Text and headings styled through the text contract tokens.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered element. A heading level sets the outline; it also picks a default size, bold weight and tight leading.

props.name: size
props.description: Maps to text.size.2 through text.size.6. Set it to make a heading look larger or smaller than its level.
props.default: "m"; for headings h1 "2xl", h2 "xl", h3 "l", h4 and h5 "m", h6 "s"

props.name: tone
props.description: Foreground role. accent follows color.accent.default, which is neutral ink in Todae, so it matches default until a theme sets a brand accent.

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight.

props.name: children
props.description: Text content.

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.description: Sets data-appearance from system, light, or dark. Nested providers override.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Written to data-appearance as is. system follows prefers-color-scheme in CSS.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Closed allowlist of raw, semantic, and component token paths, plus any keys in overrideTypes. Values are typed; unknown keys and raw CSS are rejected.

props.name: overrideTypes
props.description: Types for a company's own token paths, from the THEME_OVERRIDE_TYPES module that todae-tokens build writes. Adds those paths to the overrides allowlist.

props.name: children
props.description: Themed subtree.

components.name: Toast.Action
components.description: Button.Root for the toast's one action, such as Undo. Dismisses the toast after onClick.

props.name: variant
props.description: Button variant.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs the action. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the toast open.

components.name: Toast.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root at the end of the first row that dismisses the toast.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits names the button by itself. Otherwise the dismiss string from StringsProvider names it, Dismiss in English.
props.default: "Dismiss" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the toast is dismissed. Call event.preventDefault() to keep it open.

components.name: Toast.Description
components.description: Longer text under the title.

props.name: children
props.description: Description content.

components.name: Toast.Icon
components.description: Slot for any icon, placed before the text. aria-hidden by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon graphic from your own icon set.

components.name: Toast.Region
components.description: Where toasts show, in a popover="manual" element in the top layer. Render one near the app root. While a modal dialog in Todae's modal stack is open, the toasts move inside it so they stay usable. Takes native section attributes.

props.name: toaster
props.description: The store from createToaster().

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one toast, usually a Toast.Root.

props.name: placement
props.description: Corner or edge of the viewport. The newest toast sits nearest the edge.

props.name: layout
props.description: list shows every toast in full. stack collapses them behind the newest and spreads them while the pointer is over them or keyboard focus is inside, and from a tap with a finger or a pen that isn't hovering until a press outside or no toast is left.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many toasts show at once. Later ones wait their turn.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Key that moves focus to the toasts, such as "F8" or "Alt+T". Modifiers are Alt (or Option), Ctrl, Meta (or Cmd) and Shift. null turns it off.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the region landmark. Default is the notifications string from StringsProvider.

components.name: Toast.Root
components.description: One toast, in one of four tones. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors from color.status.<tone> through the toast contract tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Toast parts, or any content.

components.name: Toast.Title
components.description: Short summary, set in the title weight. A p element.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: ToggleGroup.Item
components.description: A secondary Button.Root with aria-pressed from the group. Takes Button.Root props except the pressed ones.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the item in the group value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this item.

props.name: children
props.description: Label, or a Button.Icon with aria-label.

components.name: ToggleGroup.Root
components.description: role="group" of toggle buttons with one tab stop and arrow-key focus. Inside a Toolbar, the toolbar owns the arrow keys. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group, such as "Alignment".

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single presses one item at most; pressing it again clears it. Multiple presses any number.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled pressed value: a value or null for single, an array for multiple.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting pressed value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new pressed value when an item is pressed.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout, and the arrow keys that move focus outside a toolbar. Horizontal items join like Button.Group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item.

props.name: children
props.description: ToggleGroup.Item elements.

components.name: Toolbar.Group
components.description: role="group" around controls that belong together. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group, such as "Text style".

props.name: children
props.description: Controls in the group.

components.name: Toolbar.Root
components.description: role="toolbar" whose controls share one tab stop, apart from text inputs and others that keep their own. Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between the focusable controls inside, wrappers included. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the toolbar. Pass this or aria-labelledby.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Left and Right move focus in a horizontal toolbar, Up and Down in a vertical one. Left and Right follow the text direction.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last control to the first and back.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons, toggles, menu triggers and other controls, with Toolbar.Group and Toolbar.Separator between them.

components.name: Toolbar.Separator
components.description: role="separator" drawn across the toolbar: a vertical rule in a horizontal toolbar, a horizontal one in a vertical toolbar. Not focusable.

components.name: Tooltip.Root
components.description: Tip chrome. Spread getTooltipProps for wire.

props.name: children
props.description: Tooltip text, or short prose plus links when interactive.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the tip surface.

props.name: style
props.description: Style for the tip surface. Anchor position comes from getTooltipProps.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

components.name: useAnnouncer
components.description: Takes no arguments and returns announce(message, options?), which reads message to screen readers through visually hidden live regions shared by the whole document; while a modal in the Todae modal stack is open, the one inside the modal in front. The props below are announce arguments.

props.name: message
props.description: Text to read. The same message twice is read twice. An empty string clears the region.

props.name: politeness
props.description: Options field. polite waits for the screen reader to finish; assertive interrupts it.

components.name: useChipField
components.description: Optional state helper. Field.ChipInput stays fully controlled without it.

props.name: initialChips
props.description: Starting chips.

props.name: initialInputValue
props.description: Starting input text.

props.name: dedupe
props.description: Skip commits that already exist.

props.name: transform
props.description: Normalize a commit. Null rejects. Default trims and rejects empty.

components.name: useChipList
components.description: Returns { listRef, measureRef, visible, hidden, measured }. visible is a prefix of chips. hidden is the +N count, capped at chips.length; 0 when maxRows is unset. measured is false on the server and before the first layout pass. Put listRef on the wrapping list (its width and gap drive the fold). The measure row on measureRef must be inert and aria-hidden and contain every chip, then a "…" probe chip, then Chip.Overflow with overflowCount={chips.length || 1}.

props.name: chips
props.description: Chip labels, in order. visible is always a prefix.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Fold chips that do not fit into +N. Unset shows every chip.

props.name: reserveWidth
props.description: Element whose computed min-width stays free on the last line. A ref so density changes stay current.

components.name: useCombobox
components.description: Headless combobox state. Spread getters onto Field, Button, Popover, BottomSheet, Dialog, and OptionList. No Combobox chrome.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single uses TextInput. Multiple uses ChipInput.

props.name: options
props.description: Sync options. Ignored when loadOptions is set.

props.name: loadOptions
props.description: Async options. Stale responses are discarded. An inline function is fine; it is read at call time.

props.name: loadKey
props.description: Reloads options when it changes. Use it when loadOptions depends on state outside the query, such as a category.

props.name: presentation
props.description: auto uses useSheetPresentation. dialog is for Dialog.Root, through getDialogProps.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Show a create row when the query has no case-insensitive label match. With loadOptions, the row waits until the load for that query settles.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Null for empty single. Array for multiple.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled filter text.

components.name: useControlledState
components.description: useControlledState(controlled, defaultValue) returns [value, setValue]. While controlled is not undefined it is the value and setValue does nothing; otherwise setValue stores the next value. It never calls a change callback.

props.name: controlled
props.description: The value prop. undefined means uncontrolled, so use null for an empty controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Read on the first render only.

components.name: useControlledValue
components.description: useControlledValue(controlled, defaultValue, onChange) returns [value, change]. change(next, ...args) skips a value equal to the one from the last render (Object.is), stores it when uncontrolled, then calls onChange(next, ...args).

props.name: controlled
props.description: The value prop. undefined means uncontrolled, so use null for an empty controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Read on the first render only.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with each new value and any extra arguments, such as a reason, controlled or not.

components.name: useDropzone
components.description: Returns { dragging, getRootProps, getInputProps }. Spread getInputProps on a native <input type="file"> and getRootProps on the drop target, usually the label around it, so a click and the keyboard open the file picker natively. Dropped folders are skipped. The picker applies accept and the hook checks dropped files against it. Files from a drop or a pick are checked against maxSize, minSize and the file count, then passed to onFiles. In the browser, the input keeps only the accepted files, so a native form submits them. dragging, and data-dragging on the root, are set while files are dragged over the root.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types to take, in the input's accept syntax: '.pdf', 'image/*', 'application/json', comma separated. The picker applies it; the hook checks dropped files against it.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take more than one file.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files to take when multiple is set. Files past it are rejected as 'too-many'.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file size in bytes.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Smallest file size in bytes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn off the input and drops.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with the files that passed and the files that did not, after a drop or a pick.

components.name: useField
components.description: Joins a custom control to the nearest Field.Root. Spread getControlProps on the control. Takes no options.

components.name: useHighlight
components.description: Returns { ref, matches }. Put ref on the element to search. matches holds a live Range per match of query, in document order, and is empty on the server. Ranges paint through CSS.highlights under name, so nothing is added to the DOM; style them with ::highlight(name). The hook searches again when text or elements under ref change.

props.name: name
props.description: Name to style with ::highlight(name). Give each hook its own name.

props.name: query
props.description: Text to find inside the element on ref. A list matches any of its terms; empty strings are skipped.

props.name: caseSensitive
props.description: Match letter case exactly.

props.name: ranges
props.description: More ranges to paint, such as the current match. They need no ref and are not added to matches.

props.name: priority
props.description: Which highlight paints on top where two overlap. Higher wins.

props.name: type
props.description: Highlight type, for spelling and grammar marks.

components.name: useHotkey
components.description: useHotkey(hotkey, handler, options). Listens for keydown on the document and runs handler when a key matches hotkey, after preventing its default. It skips keys something else already prevented, keys pressed while an IME composes, held keys, and, in a text field, every key except a function key or a chord with Meta, or with Control but not Alt.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: A key with its modifiers, such as "Control+K", "Alt+T" or "F8". Modifiers must match exactly. A list matches any of them. One with a modifier name it does not know is off.

props.name: handler
props.description: Runs on a match. An inline function is fine; the latest one is read at key time.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Listen only while true. Pass it in the options object.

components.name: useModalLayer
components.description: useModalLayer(ref, open). Puts a modal <dialog> of your own in Todae's modal stack once open is true and it is shown with showModal(), until close(). Toast.Region moves its toasts into the modal in front. Dialog and BottomSheet join the stack by themselves.

props.name: ref
props.description: The <dialog>. Render it in the component that calls the hook, which reads the ref each time that component renders.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog may be shown. It joins once this is true and it is shown with showModal(), and stays until close().

components.name: usePopover
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getPopoverProps onto Popover.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires on toggle or dismiss. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: Sets CSS anchor-name on this element and excludes it from outside press.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Focus this element when the popover opens.

props.name: restoreFocusRef
props.description: Return focus here when the popover closes.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False skips toggle, dismiss, and focus moves.

props.name: haspopup
props.description: aria-haspopup on the trigger. Use "listbox" for an OptionList in a role-less popover.

props.name: id
props.description: Popover id. Default is a generated id.

components.name: useRovingFocus
components.description: One tab stop for a composite. Spread getContainerProps on the group and getItemProps(value) on each item.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move focus. Left and Right swap in a right-to-left container.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last item to the first and back.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Typing focuses the next item whose text starts with the typed characters.

props.name: tabStop
props.description: Keep one item tabbable. False when focus only enters from code, as in a menu: every item gets tabIndex -1.

props.name: findItems
props.description: Finds the items, enabled or not, instead of getItemProps. Such items have no value, so no tab stop is kept: the hook only moves focus.

props.name: activeValue
props.description: Controlled tab stop. Falls back to the first enabled item when null, disabled or missing.

props.name: defaultActiveValue
props.description: Initial tab stop when uncontrolled.

props.name: onActiveValueChange
props.description: Fires when an item other than activeValue takes focus, including a fallback tab stop, so a controlled owner can pin it.

components.name: useSheetPresentation
components.description: Coarse pointer or narrow width selects sheet. SSR and first paint are popover. isSheet mirrors presentation.

props.name: narrowWidth
props.description: Viewport width that starts the narrow media query. Media is max-width: n - 1.

props.name: coarseQuery
props.description: matchMedia query treated as coarse pointer.

props.name: forced
props.description: Skip media when popover or sheet. auto uses coarse OR narrow.

components.name: useTooltip
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getTooltipProps onto Tooltip. Interactive is a non-modal tip dialog.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Use the non-modal tip dialog. Links only. Never role=tooltip.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires after a commit. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: showDelay
props.description: Hover show delay in milliseconds. Focus shows at once.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Hide delay in milliseconds.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False resets intent and commits close.

props.name: id
props.description: Tooltip id. Default is a generated id.

components.name: VisuallyHidden.Root
components.description: Hides content on screen and keeps it for assistive technology. A span with no role; takes native span attributes.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Shows the content again while focus is on it or inside it, for a skip link.

props.name: children
props.description: Text for assistive technology, or a focusable element such as a skip link.
